title: Recursive block of a sign vector
statement: Let $n$ and $d$ be natural numbers, let $x\in\{-1,1\}^{n^{d+1}}$, and let $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The $i$th recursive block of $x$ is the sign vector of length $n^d$ obtained by fixing the first index to $i$ under the standard identification of the coordinates with an index in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and an index in $\{0,\ldots,n^d-1\}$.
